name: AppleTycoon
summary: A real tycoon: every player gets a base where droppers drop the game's item onto a conveyor, each machine over the belt turns it into the next thing and multiplies its worth, a seller pays the owner, and buy pads unlock the next dropper, machine or speed-up in order.

needs.map: Workspace.AppleMap.Tycoons.<n> (Model): Spawn, Conveyor (anchored; its RightVector is the belt's direction), Seller, Drops, Pads.<id> (parts with a BillboardGui whose TextLabel is Label); ServerStorage.AppleTycoonParts.<n>.<id> for every unlockable (a dropper Model holds a Spout part, a machine Model a Gate part on the belt)
needs.config: AppleGameConfig.tycoon = { item = {name, color, value}, belt = {speed}, droppers = {[id] = {every, value?}}, machines = {[id] = {times, color, becomes, material?}}, unlocks = {{id, label, price, after?}}, start = {ids}, speedUps = {[id] = speed} }
needs.screen: StarterGui.TycoonHUD with a TextLabel named Value; ReplicatedStorage.AppleComponents.AppleClientConfig.currency

gives.bases: each joining player claims the first free base (attribute Owner) and spawns on its Spawn; leaving resets it
gives.income: items pay the base owner at the seller, worth item.value times every machine they passed under
gives.progress: a pad shows once what it needs is owned; stepping on it with the price buys it (AppleEconomy.spend) and the thing appears
gives.limits: at most 30 live items a base, each gone after 40 seconds
